headline: Chile's IPSA Index Drops 2.76% to Three-Month Low Tracking Wall Street Tech Rout
summary: Chile's benchmark IPSA fell 2.76% to 10,254 on October 30, reaching its lowest close in three months following a sell-off in US technology stocks.
why: The IPSA tracks the largest and most liquid stocks on the Santiago Stock Exchange and reflects investor sentiment across Latin America.

impacts.name: S&P IPSA
impacts.why: The benchmark index declined 2.76% to 10,254 amid a global tech-led sell-off.
